rule_description: Production filter rule that gates cycle 1 LR filter application by per-sample caller F1 and FP density. Filter is applied only when both gates qualify; otherwise filter is skipped to preserve caller F1 baseline.

gate_conditions.rationale: Cycle 2 cross-sample evidence: 3/4 new samples with caller F1 > 0.83 had FP density < 4% — LR filter found no useful threshold. HCC1937 (F1=0.37, FP density 16%) was the only generalize-positive. Conservative gate at 0.80 + 0.10 ensures filter only applies where there is headroom.

filter_application.refit_method: 5-fold StratifiedKFold OOF, L2 LR C=1.0, seed=42, swept τ
filter_application.skip_rationale: Cycle 2 transfer-mode catastrophe on HCC1954 (-0.377 ΔF1) due to caller_af coefficient overfit HCC1395 AF distribution. Skip preserves caller F1 baseline.

scope_caveats: Only validated on caller F1 < 0.80 AND FP density > 0.10 samples
Cycle 2 cross-sample DIRECTION_NEGATIVE proved transfer mode catastrophic on high-F1 samples

**ISM methylation features VESTIGIAL** (cycle 3 Step 1.5 ablation 2026-05-20): drop 5 methyl features 後 HCC1395 refit ΔF1 +0.02236 → +0.02171 (drop +0.00065 = 3% of uplift, well under Cohen +0.003); 4/5 樣本 no-methyl ΔF1 ≥ full; HPFineF coef +0.75 為 caller_af L2 ridge-split 非 incremental signal
Production filter 改用 4-feature (caller_af + LOH_inner + Coverage_Multiple + NG); 5 methyl features 留在 characterization 用途但不在 filter
Caller_af shrinkage ablation: 修補 67% (HCC1954) ~ 90% (H1437) transfer-mode disaster — caller_af 為主 confound 但仍餘 25%+ 未解釋 (需 A2 KS test 補強)
Per-sample re-fit required; no single transferable τ across samples

ablation_reframe_2026_05_20.H_M1a_verdict: FAIL (drop +0.00065 < +0.003 threshold; 4/5 樣本 no-methyl ΔF1 ≥ full)
